quote: One group saw the measure described as saving 150 lives.
content: Replication check: I found no direct replication of the airport-equipment study itself, but the effect it illustrates, proportion dominance, has been reproduced and extended. Bartels (2006) found that people favored relative over absolute savings across several domains, and that the preference varied considerably between people and presentations. The earlier refugee-camp version (Fetherstonhaugh et al. 1997) shows the same pattern. The demonstration is sound; whether "affect" is the mechanism, rather than evaluability, is a separate question the essay leaves open.
